info.name: RPS - Parking App API
info.description:
Standalone Postman collection containing ONLY the six parking-terminal endpoints (parkingInit / entranceCall / exitCall / exitPayment / vehiclePresent / help). Extracted from the master Remote Parking Server collection for handoff to the client-app development team - the admin / JCC / Tell / internal-debug requests in the master collection are intentionally omitted.

**Read first:** `Documents/ClientApp_Integration_Guide.md` and `Documents/HMAC_TerminalAuth.md`.

**Setup:**
1. Edit the collection variables `hmac_client_id` and `hmac_secret` (or override them in a Postman Environment for production credentials so they never end up in a collection export).
2. Set `base_url` to the dev/UAT/prod hostname you were given.
3. Set `outlet`, `terminal_number`, `company_code` to the values for the parking area you are testing against.
4. Open any request and hit Send - the collection-level pre-request script signs every request with HMAC-SHA256 automatically.

**Defaults ship pointing at dev:** the `hmac_client_id` / `hmac_secret` values below match the public dev sandbox documented in the integration guide (§3). Safe to use against the dev API; **must** be overridden for UAT/Prod.

The pre-request script is identical to the one in `src/RPS.Api/Authentication/HmacAuthenticationHandler.cs` and `src/RPS.HmacSample/ParkingHmacSigner.cs`. If a request returns 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: hmacauth ... error="..."`, see `Documents/ClientApp_Integration_Guide.md` §7 for the error catalogue and signature-mismatch checklist.

variable.description: Scheme + host + port of the target RPS API. Override per environment (dev / UAT / prod).

Identifies the terminal/client to the parking API. Must match a key in the server's Hmac:Clients map. The default ships matching the public dev sandbox; override for UAT/Prod with the per-terminal value you were issued.

Base64-encoded shared secret for hmac_client_id. The default matches the public dev sandbox secret; safe to use against the dev API only. For UAT/Prod, override in a Postman Environment (Postman -> Environments) so the real secret never lands in a collection export.
10-digit outlet/parking-area identifier. Matches ParkingAreas.OutletNumber on the server.
12-digit terminal identifier within the parking area. Matches Terminals.TerminalNumber on the server.
Company code sent in entranceCall / exitCall / exitPayment / help bodies. Same value for every terminal of an installation.
Sample SHA-512 card token used in bank-card entrance / exit requests. Any 128-char hex string works for dev smoke tests; in production the ECR produces this on the device.

exec: // Stamps every request in this collection with an Authorization header
// in the wire format the server expects:
//   hmac_client_id   matches a key in the server's Hmac:Clients map
//   hmac_secret      Base64-encoded shared secret for that client
throw new Error('Set hmac_client_id and hmac_secret collection variables to use the parking endpoints.');
// Path + query, with {{variables}} resolved. Strip scheme://host so we
// sign only what the server sees as Request.Path + QueryString.
// Body bytes (after variable substitution); empty string for GET / no body.
const sigBase = clientId + method + encodedPath + timestamp + nonce + bodyHash;
const authValue = 'hmacauth ' + clientId + ':' + signature + ':' + nonce + ':' + timestamp;
// Toggle to true when debugging a 401. The server logs the same fields
// in its 'HMAC auth failed: ...' warning so byte-level mismatches are easy to spot.

request.description: Initialize terminal. Returns config, charges, messages, available spaces. `versionName` and `versionNumber` identify the terminal application version. Full contract: `Documents/parkingInit.md`.
Initialize terminal (POST variant). Same as GET but with JSON body. Full contract: `Documents/parkingInit.md`.
Driver pressed HELP button. Creates a help request and notifies admin/user via SignalR. Full contract: `Documents/help.md`.
Help call triggered by ECR decline event.

    "companyCode": "{{company_code}}",

request.description: Help call triggered by communication/technical error.
Check if a vehicle is present at the entrance/exit via barrier controller. Full contract: `Documents/vehiclePresent.md`.
Vehicle entering with a bank card. Pre-authorization already done by ECR on the Android device. Full contract: `Documents/entranceCall.md`.
Vehicle entering with a monthly card. authCode=111111 and referenceNo=112233445566 are hardcoded identifiers for monthly cards.

Vehicle exiting with bank card. RPS matches token to entrance record, calculates fee, and handles payment scenarios:
- Scenario 1: Amount = 0 -> barrier opens, pre-auth released
- Scenario 2: Amount <= pre-auth -> barrier opens, capture amount
- Scenario 3: Amount > pre-auth -> topup attempted, if declined returns moneyToPay for ECR

Full contract: `Documents/exitCall.md`.
Monthly card exit. Typically zero amount -> barrier opens immediately.

Called after Scenario 3 when topup was declined and ECR payment was processed on the Android device. If responseCode=00 and authCode is present, RPS opens barrier and records payment. Full contract: `Documents/exitPayment.md`.
ECR payment was declined on the Android device. Barrier stays closed.
